title: SEAT BACK- FINAL TRIM
summary: Final trim on the back of the bucket seat: the seat back panel (the hard plastic rear shell of the seat back, painted interior trim color), the escutcheon around the seat back lock release at the top, and on coupes an escutcheon for the shoulder harness opening in the upper seat back. The trim cover edges are hog-ringed to the frame; the seat back panel hooks on with its top tab routed through a slit in the trim, is screwed through a bracket at the top and with a screw at the bottom; the escutcheons are screwed on.
